webhooks.detail: Registered webhooks notify when a routine run finishes (signed deliveries, webhook_id on run requests). No general event-subscription catalog; also inbound table webhooks.

evidence.quote: Get notified when a routine run finishes, then verify and handle the delivery.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox or free-dev-account page in developers.clay.com llms.txt index. Public API access likely tied to a Clay workspace/plan; not confirmed free.

evidence.quote: Limits may differ for specific workspaces. Contact Clay if you need higher limits.

rate_limits.summary: 300 requests/min per workspace (~5/s), shared across API keys; 429 with Retry-After; some endpoints have own limits

evidence.quote: When a request is rate limited, Clay returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds to wait).
Build with Clay from your coding agent, or call the Clay API from your own applications.
